verdict.rationale: Together AI is an API-first platform with REST/SDK access (TypeScript client, OpenAI-compatible API), batch inference, fine-tuning via API/CLI, and dedicated endpoints with autoscaling — all of which are inherently usable headlessly in CI/automation pipelines without any UI dependency. Function calling and agentic multi-step tool use further support automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration), documented non-interactive CLI auth/config for scripted environments, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
